candidates.title: Pre-redemption SPAC trust-claim discount convergence
candidates.hypothesis: For a survivorship-safe universe of pre-deal SPAC common shares, a quoted price below the filing-vintage net redemption claim by more than all fees, deadline risk, cash-lockup carry, liquidity cost and completion uncertainty represents a bounded contractual convergence opportunity; buying the common share and submitting a timely redemption should earn non-trend return as the cash claim is paid.

market_prior.provenance: The proxy formula is frozen; no issuer-level value is claimed in this lead because the local universe and quote snapshot are absent.

independent_evidence.evidence: filing-vintage trust value, redemption right, deadline and completion terms

expectation_gap.gap_definition: net redemption claim minus common-share ask minus fees, carry, liquidity cost, deadline risk reserve and completion-risk reserve

transmission.expected_direction: positive convergence to net cash claim
transmission.catalyst: valid shareholder redemption followed by trust cash release

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: The residual can survive only if small capacity, corporate-action deadlines, cash lockup, odd-lot/liquidity costs, deal-extension uncertainty and broker eligibility make it operationally unattractive to large funds; those frictions must be measured rather than narrated.
candidates.falsifier: Reject if a survivorship-safe PIT replay finds fewer than 20 eligible settled redemptions, if broker submission cannot be made reliably, or if net redemption proceeds fail to beat cash and the displaced cash-feasible core candidate after all fees, carry, slippage, delayed settlement and loss-tail scenarios.

baseline.policy: Hold cash or admit the current cash-feasible core candidate; do not enter a SPAC solely because its headline price is below a stale trust estimate.
baseline.universe: cash plus the frozen cash-feasible core candidate set

treatment.policy: Admit only a PIT-eligible SPAC common share whose executable ask is below a filing-vintage net redemption claim by a predeclared all-in safety margin and whose broker redemption cutoff, position settlement and account eligibility are verified before entry.

candidates.replacement_value_comparator: cash yield, SPY, QQQ and the exact cash-feasible core candidate displaced under identical capital, settlement and cost constraints

execution_envelope.intended_instrument: long SPAC common share with an account-eligible redemption instruction; no warrants or options
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: executable ask, ADV, spread, settlement date and position-size cap before the broker cutoff
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: commissions, spread/slippage, cash opportunity cost, redemption fees, delayed cash release and adverse deal-extension scenarios
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: one small default-off paper sleeve with issuer and aggregate notional caps; no production orders
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: purchase must settle and the redemption instruction must be accepted before the broker-specific cutoff

prediction.confidence_reason: The payoff is contract-linked and direction-light, but no local PIT universe, issuer rows, broker deadline contract or settled sample exists yet.

candidates.reopen_condition: Freeze at least 30 unique issuer-deadline observations and at least 20 independently settled redemptions with filing-vintage claim, executable ask, broker cutoff, fees and cash-release date.
candidates.next_machine_action: Debate source and execution assumptions, then run D0-D3; do not reserve an experiment while any referenced surface is snapshot-only or has zero overlap.

candidates.title: Fungible ADR versus home-share parity convergence
candidates.hypothesis: For legally fungible ADR/home-share pairs, a synchronized ratio- and FX-adjusted price gap wider than conversion, settlement, borrow, tax, spread and stale-clock costs should converge through depositary issuance/cancellation or cross-venue arbitrage and can produce non-trend relative-value return.

market_prior.provenance: Formula only; no synchronized issuer-level value is claimed in this lead.

independent_evidence.evidence: ADR ratio, legal fungibility, issuance/cancellation fees, settlement lag and restrictions

expectation_gap.gap_definition: absolute synchronized parity deviation minus FX, conversion, settlement, borrow, tax, spread, impact and stale-clock costs

transmission.expected_direction: cheap leg up and/or rich leg down toward ratio-adjusted parity
transmission.catalyst: cross-venue trading and depositary issuance or cancellation

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: Non-overlapping trading hours, capital controls, FX, depositary fees, settlement latency, borrow scarcity, conversion suspensions and quote fragmentation can widen the no-arbitrage band; only the residual outside a fully measured band is a candidate edge.
candidates.falsifier: Reject if synchronized executable gaps do not exceed the full no-arbitrage band at least 20 independent times, if either leg cannot be executed or hedged, or if the after-cost pair fails to beat cash while keeping residual market and FX beta within the predeclared cap.

baseline.policy: Hold cash; do not trade a relative-value pair from asynchronous last prices.

treatment.policy: Enter the cheap claim and hedge the rich claim only when both executable quotes, FX, fungibility, borrow, conversion cost and settlement clocks are simultaneously bound and the residual exceeds a frozen safety margin.

candidates.replacement_value_comparator: cash, an unhedged cheap-leg purchase, and the exact cash-feasible core candidate displaced under identical capital and cost limits

execution_envelope.intended_instrument: paired ADR and home-market shares with explicit FX hedge where available
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: synchronized executable quotes, market overlap or hedged stale-clock interval, ADV and conversion capacity
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: two-leg spreads, commissions, FX, tax, depositary fees, borrow, settlement and legging loss
execution_envelope.borrow_dependency: required for the rich leg unless an inventory-backed conversion route is proven
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: pair-level and venue-level notional caps with no naked directional fallback
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: both legs and FX hedge must be executable within a predeclared clock tolerance

prediction.confidence_reason: Published evidence suggests typical deviations are only basis points and largely explained by arbitrage costs; current Moomoo coverage is not an executable cross-market surface.

candidates.reopen_condition: Bind at least 30 synchronized executable decisions across at least 10 fungible pairs, with 20 settled after-cost convergence observations and complete FX, borrow and conversion terms.
candidates.next_machine_action: Park at source preflight unless a licensed synchronized FX and cross-venue quote surface plus issuer conversion-term ledger can be named.

candidates.title: Assignment-aware executable put-call parity residual
candidates.hypothesis: For a liquid option series, an executable put-call parity residual that remains after stock and option spreads, rates, dividends, borrow, early-exercise and assignment reserves, commissions and multi-leg fill risk should converge or settle to the replicated claim value and can produce non-trend conversion/reversal return.

market_prior.provenance: Formula only; the current options observer is not a simultaneous executable parity surface.

independent_evidence.evidence: contract exercise and assignment mechanics plus PIT dividend, rate and borrow terms

expectation_gap.gap_definition: executable conversion or reversal proceeds minus replicated claim value minus all spreads, carry, dividend, borrow, assignment, commission and legging reserves

transmission.expected_direction: residual converges toward the assignment-aware replicated value
transmission.catalyst: arbitrage trading, exercise or expiry settlement

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: Apparent residuals are often stale or non-executable; American exercise, dividends, borrow scarcity, quote fragmentation, margin and legging risk create a wide real no-arbitrage band, especially for a personal account.
candidates.falsifier: Reject if fewer than 30 independent executable quote sets survive the all-in band, if atomic or safely staged execution is unavailable, or if assignment-aware realized PnL fails to beat cash after margin usage and tail reserves.

baseline.policy: Hold cash; do not trade a parity residual calculated from midpoint or asynchronous quotes.

treatment.policy: Enter a conversion or reversal only when simultaneous executable stock, call and put prices plus PIT rate, dividend, borrow and assignment reserves leave a frozen positive residual after every leg and margin cost.

candidates.replacement_value_comparator: cash return on the same margin and capital, plus the exact cash-feasible core candidate displaced

execution_envelope.intended_instrument: stock plus matched-strike matched-expiry call and put conversion or reversal
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: simultaneous executable stock and option quotes, open interest, size and conservative legging reserve
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: all leg spreads and commissions, rates, dividends, borrow, margin, exercise/assignment fees and early-exercise reserve
execution_envelope.borrow_dependency: required for reversal or replaced by proven stock inventory for conversion
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: one-contract paper unit until at least 30 independent settled decisions; no naked residual leg
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: quotes and carry inputs must share one decision timestamp within a frozen tolerance

prediction.confidence_reason: The identity is sound, but an executable residual is much rarer than a screen residual and the repository options family is already heavily rejected.

candidates.reopen_condition: Freeze at least 100 simultaneous executable quote sets and at least 30 settled one-contract decisions with PIT dividend, rate, borrow and assignment outcomes.
candidates.next_machine_action: Apply history and options-family veto before any data build; park unless the executable quote and assignment ledger are genuinely new surfaces.
